## 2. Verified Items

### 2.1 Algebraic identity [T1]

```
tan(α) − cot(α) = −2 cot(2α)
```

Verified symbolically: LHS = (sin²α − cos²α)/(sinα cosα),
RHS (after expanding cos(2α)/sin(2α)) = same rational expression.
Residual = 0 [VERIFIED-sympy exact].

### 2.2 Hopf coframe (metric ds²=dα²+cos²α dθ²+sin²α dφ²)

Orthonormal coframe:
```
e¹ = dα,  e² = cos(α) dθ,  e³ = sin(α) dφ
```

Exterior derivatives [T3–T5]:
```
de¹ = 0
de² = −tan(α) e¹∧e²
de³ = +cot(α) e¹∧e³
```

### 2.3 Spin connection from Cartan equations (torsion-free) [T6–T8]

Unique solution to de^a + ω^a_b ∧ e^b = 0:
```
ω¹₂ = +tan(α) e²  =  sin(α) dθ       ← α-dependent
ω¹₃ = −cot(α) e³  = −cos(α) dφ       ← α-dependent
ω²₃ = 0
```

All three Cartan equations satisfied identically [VERIFIED-sympy].

### 2.4 Connection coefficients are α-dependent [T9–T10]

```
ω¹₂ / e²  =  tan(α)    (d/dα ≠ 0)
ω¹₃ / e³  = −cot(α)    (d/dα ≠ 0)
```

Their sum:  tan(α) + (−cot α) = tan(α) − cot(α) = −2cot(2α)

### 2.5 Curvature = unit S³ (frame-independent) [T11–T13]

```
R¹₂ = e¹∧e²,   R¹₃ = e¹∧e³,   R²₃ = e²∧e³
```

Sectional curvature K = +1 in all three planes [VERIFIED-sympy]. Confirms the geometry

### 2.6 Invariant frame — Maurer-Cartan [T14]

Left-invariant 1-forms (same convention as G0 evidence):
```
σ₁ = sin(θ+φ) dα + sin(α)cos(α)cos(θ+φ)(dφ−dθ)
σ₂ = −cos(θ+φ) dα + sin(α)cos(α)sin(θ+φ)(dφ−dθ)
σ₃ = cos²(α) dθ + sin²(α) dφ   = ξ̃  (G0 Killing form)
```

Maurer-Cartan ratio:
```
dσ₃ / (σ₁∧σ₂) = 2   ← pure integer, independent of α, θ, φ
```

∂_α(ratio) = ∂_θ(ratio) = ∂_φ(ratio) = 0 [VERIFIED-sympy].

The connection structure in the invariant frame has structure constants **{0, ±1, ±2}**
(integers), not functions of α. In particular, **no cot(2α) term**.

The G0 report falsified the claim "ω_ab = (1/2)ε_abc e_c". The correct Hopf connection is:

The factor "(1/2)" would appear only for a differently normalized convention.
**The Hopf frame and the invariant frame have completely different spin connections.**
